name: token-router
description: Picks the model and effort for each prompt by how hard the task is, and only switches when the saving beats the prompt-cache cost.

maxModel.title: Strongest model
maxModel.description: The most capable (and expensive) model the router may choose.

minModel.title: Cheapest model
minModel.description: The cheapest model the router may choose.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: auto: rules first, a Haiku call for unclear prompts. rules: never calls a model.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long a model's cached context stays warm; used to price a switch back.
